From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@zenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & pricing next steps - ZenHealth

Hi Tom / Sarah —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Per our conversation attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the ZenHealth pilot and potential production rollout (file: ZenHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx). Key items below — please confirm owners and dates so we can lock this in for procurement.

High-level milestones (draft):
- Pilot kickoff (environment & SSO): Owner: ZenHealth IT (Sarah) — Target: 2026-07-15
- Data ingestion & schema mapping: Owner: ZenHealth Data Eng (Tom) — Target: 2026-07-29
- Pilot validation & success criteria run: Owner: ZenHealth Product — Target: 2026-08-19
- Contract & procurement sign: Owner: ZenHealth Procurement — Target close: 2026-07-31
- Production rollout (A/B ramp): Owner: Redwood Inference — Target: 2026-09-01

Dependencies we called out on the call:
1) Procurement needs (PO terms + redline window) — Sarah / Procurement to confirm timeline
2) Security evidence: SOC 2 report and data residency controls — we can provide SOC2 Type II and specific logs
3) Pricing & commit decision (discount / credits) — customer requested pricing guidance to confirm budget

Requested next steps:
- Please review the attached MAP and mark any edits in the sheet by EOD Friday (2026-06-12)
- Confirm target close date of 2026-07-31 or propose alternate
- Tom/Sarah: confirm who will own each milestone in the sheet

On pricing: I understand you asked about discounted pricing/credits on the call. To unblock procurement internally, I will escalate for an exec pricing review. To prepare, can you confirm expected commit level (monthly token estimate or monthly $ commit) and whether a 12-month term is likely? That will materially affect the discount we can offer.

Attachment: ZenHealth_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the edits.

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — the MAP looks good overall. A couple of notes:

- We can own the Data ingestion milestone; I'll assign our data engineer to the sheet today.
- Procurement: we typically need a 2-week window to review contract language and PO approval; target close of 2026-07-31 sounds tight but feasible if pricing is approved this week.

On pricing: our CFO is pushing for a 30% discount off list for the first year and a $50k one-time implementation credit. We are prepared to commit to a 12-month term if we can get that pricing and a standard SLA.

If you need exact monthly token volumes, we estimate roughly 100m tokens/month for pilot scale (burstable to ~250m/month in month 3).

Can you escalate for pricing approval? Procurement is standing by for the final term sheet.

Tom

Tom — thanks for the quick reply and the volume estimate, that helps a lot. I uploaded an updated MAP (ZenHealth_MAP_v1_updated.xlsx) with the owners you confirmed.

To be transparent on our side: a 30% discount + $50k credit at the estimated commit (100m tokens/month) is above the standard mid-market approval line and will need exec pricing sign-off. To keep momentum we can propose an interim commercial offer while I escalate:
- Proposed interim: 25% discount off list for year 1 + $25k implementation credit, contingent on execution of a 12-month commitment and a firm PO by 2026-07-15.

If ZenHealth prefers to hold for the 30%/50k ask, I will open an exec pricing review and need to provide: deal economics, expected ARR, reference case, and commit timeline (PO date). Can you confirm whether you can get a PO by 2026-07-15 if we provide the 30%/50k?

I will also attach a pricing term sheet (pricing_term_sheet.pdf) for Procurement to review; procurement items we will need: PO terms, any vendor-side legal redlines, and billing contact.

I will escalate now to request exec pricing approval. If possible, please confirm PO timeline by EOD tomorrow so I can include that in the submission.

Thanks —
Marissa

Aditya / Vivek / Dylan —

Forwarding a short thread with ZenHealth. TL;DR: strong product fit, pilot -> production opportunity; customer requests 30% discount + $50k implementation credit for a 12-month commitment. They estimate ~100m tokens/month for pilot and could ramp. Procurement needs final term sheet and a PO to approve by ~2026-07-15.

Deal summary (high level):
- Account: ZenHealth (Healthcare SaaS)
- Deal id: ZEN-4782
- ARR if converted at list pricing: ~$320k/year (annualized from expected monthly consumption)
- Proposed commercial asks from customer: 30% discount + $50k credit
- Proposed commercial we can offer to accelerate: 25% discount + $25k credit (conditional on 12-month commit and PO by 2026-07-15)
- Key risk: procurement timeline and SOC2 evidence requests (we have SOC2 Type II and can provide necessary artifacts)

Attachments: pricing_term_sheet.pdf (proposed interim commercial + contract side bullets)

Request: Can we get exec approval to offer the interim commercial (25% + $25k) to close quickly? If you prefer to approve the customer ask (30% + $50k) I will note approval and update the term sheet to send to Procurement. Customer is pressing for decision this week to meet their procurement window.

If you need more detail I can pull the ARR math and model margin impact; otherwise a quick thumbs-up here will let me send the term sheet to procurement and lock the 2026-07-31 target close.

Thanks —
